scope: TeamClass::Recalc over TaskForce totals, member counts and strength bytes; Calc_Center off action 10 over synthetic members and move targets; Recruit over one class array with supplied Can_Add answers; ObjectClass::Distance to a Foot or a building of every foundation; the action 5 guard timer; action 54's point up to its FNPC call; FindOwnBuilding over one house's buildings; Find_Best_Target_Building over BuildingClass::Array with four houses; action 53 up to its FNPC call or its early return; Quarry_To_Threat; Coordinate_Attack's frame test; EnterBioReactor over one house's absorber list with supplied CAN_LOAD answers; EnterBattleBunker over one house's occupiable list with supplied CanBeOccupiedBy answers; EnterTankBunker over one house's tank bunker list; actions 14, 9 and 8 and action 43's inline test over up to five synthetic infantry, vehicle and aircraft members.
assumptions: x87 control word 0x0E7F (PC53, chop), the harness default.
Fixture objects carry only the fields the entries read.
ScenarioInit (0xA8E7AC), the empty coordinate 0xB0E968 and the empty cell 0xB0E948 read zero, as at load (BSS).
substitutions: WhatAmI (vt+0x2C), GetTechnoType (vt+0x84), the GuardSlower weight (vt+0x4E0), Can_Enter_Cell (vt+0x1AC) and SetTarget (vt+0x3C8) answer from the case; objects' GetCoords is the original 0x5F65A0, a building's answers the case's coordinate.
ScriptClass::Current 0x691500 answers action 0; MapClass::GetCellAt 0x565730 records its coordinate and answers one cell; the team destructor (vt+0x20) records its call.

Can_Add 0x6EA610 answers from the case and Add_Member 0x6EA500 records its call; Get_Group 0x6F1870 answers the case's group; the TeamType waypoint 0x6F18A0 answers the empty cell; the first passenger 0x473450 answers none.
Base_Center 0x50DF30 answers the case's centres ([0, 0] for none, z 0); RandomRanged 0x65C7E0 answers from the case and records its range.

Find_Best_Target_Building: a building's GetCoords (vt+0x48) answers the case's coordinate; the threat map read 0x56BCD0 answers the scored building's case value and records its cell and house; IsAlliedWith 0x4F9A50 runs on the houses' ArrayIndex (+0x30) and Allies bits (+0x5788).

EnterBioReactor's Transmit_Message (vt+0x278) answers the case's CAN_LOAD reply and records it; Queue_Mission (vt+0x1E8) and Assign_Destination (vt+0x480) record their calls; the pick is read from EDI at 0x4DFC52.

EnterBattleBunker's BuildingClass::CanBeOccupiedBy 0x457CE0 answers the case's admission for the Foot, refuses NULL as its first test (0x457CEB) does, and records its building and occupant; Queue_Mission and Assign_Destination record their calls.

EnterTankBunker: the current weapon (vt+0x3F4) answers a weapon with or without a type; Transmit_Message, Queue_Mission and Assign_Destination record their calls; RadioClass::Contact 0x65AD30 runs as original and records its building; the admission's answer is read from AL at 0x4DFF54.

The transport actions: Get_Mission (vt+0x184) and Ready_To_Commence (vt+0x200) answer from the case; Queue_Mission, Assign_Destination, Assign_Target, Commence (vt+0x1EC) and TeamClass::Remove_Member 0x6EA870 record their calls; MapClass::GetCellAt 0x565730 records its coordinate and answers one cell, for which Look_up_building_in_cell 0x47C520 answers the member's case (its game-active gate 0xA8E9A0 is set in play); In_Radio_Contact 0x65AE30 and Set_ArchiveTarget 0x70C610 run as original; action 43 runs from 0x6E9C22 to its branch targets.

Action 9: Mark (vt+0x124) and Flush_For_Placement 0x45EE70 record their calls; the DeploysInto= building's CanPlaceAt (vt+0xA8) answers the case's placement and records its cell and house; GetMapCoords (vt+0x1B8) is the original 0x41BEA0.
